Book Now Book Now Overview Experience Located 40 km from Udupi, the Seethanadi Nature Camp in Hebri is certainly an escape from the maddening rush of daily life. Amidst refreshing greenery, this lovely camp takes you away from the furore of cities. Besides setting out on nature walks and admiring the marvels of nature, the camp organizes a number of activities for its guests. Head here for a hassle free vacation. This Nature camp is situated inside Someshwara Wildlife Sanctuary. This Sanctuary protects the last remaining low elevation rain forests in entire Western Ghats. Nature Walk Step into the nature with our naturalists. Our guided nature walks offer a close-up look at the ecosystem, covering native flora, birdlife, insects, and animal tracks. Designed for all ages, this immersive walk explores the woods beyond the traditional safari. Night Trail Discover nature after dark. Guided safely by our trained naturalists within our campus, the night trail reveals nocturnal biodiversity including insects, spiders, amphibians, and nocturnal birds. It is a thrilling experience that showcases the wild when the rest of the world is asleep. No modification, if requested within 24 hours to check in. Travel Tips Dress for comfort. Do avoid bright colours and stick to muted shades of green, black, grey and brown. The more you meld with the background, the better. Wear comfortable walking shoes. Avoid smoking – anything can start a forest fire. You’ll be spending a lot of time outdoors. Don’t forget your hat, sunscreen, sunglasses, torch, etc. Avoid plastics. We’re really trying to cut down on plastics.
